If clicking on the link displays:
"This gallery has been removed or is unavailable.
You will be redirected to the front page momentarily."
, it indicates one of the following reasons:
1. Your proxy IP is located in Japan. You need to change your proxy IP.
2. e-hentai blocks most galleries on dmm.com. You need to access "ex", not "e-".
如果点进去显示的是：
“This gallery has been removed or is unavailable.
You will be redirected to the front page momentarily.”
说明有以下原因：
1、你挂的代理的IP是日本地区的，需要你更换代理IP即可
2、e-hentai屏蔽了大部分dmm.com的画廊，需要进的是“ex”而不是“e-”
